commands.command: echo '=== Checking prisma/dev.db ===' && sqlite3 prisma/dev.db '.tables' 2>/dev/null && sqlite3 prisma/dev.db 'SELECT count(*) as job_count FROM Job;' 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && echo '=== Checking current dev.db tables ===' && sqlite3 dev.db '.tables' 2>/dev/null && sqlite3 dev.db '.schema Job' 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && echo '=== Try stash 7 (before postgres switch) ===' && git stash show stash@{7} -- dev.db 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && echo '=== Restore stash 7 dev.db to temp file ===' && git show stash@{7}:dev.db > /tmp/old-dev.db 2>/dev/null && sqlite3 /tmp/old-dev.db 'SELECT count(*) as job_count FROM Job;' 2>/dev/null && sqlite3 /tmp/old-dev.db 'SELECT title, company FROM Job LIMIT 5;' 2>/dev/null
commands.description: Check prisma/dev.db and recover data from git stash before PostgreSQL switch
